## Entities

### <a id="dev-bcm4339"></a>BCM4339 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth and SDIO

`dev.bcm4339` | device | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/kmod/bcmdhd.ko`, `kernel.modules:wlanMemoryAllocator`

Broadcom BCM4339 combo chip on SDIO with the bcmdhd driver, CLM regulatory blobs and the WLAN loader.

Aliases: `bcmdhd`, `CLM`, `mmcio_mount`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` BCM4339 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth capability and tuning surface, bcmdhd insmod arguments, compiled defaults, CLM ownership and the a6400 vs ZV-E10 WLAN/BT differences were analysed statically; CLM blobs were parsed. ([E0406](../evidence/0406-bcm4339-wifi-bt-tuning-surface-readonly.md), [E0407](../evidence/0407-bcm4339-insmod-args-and-zve10-diff.md), [E0408](../evidence/0408-clm-blob-and-wlan-baseline.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` On one unit, enabling Wi-Fi from the camera menu rebooted the camera every time (WLAN-loader error-path null write after an mmcio_mount failure); preload interference was ruled out and an SDIO fault confirmed for that unit. ([E0409](../evidence/0409-wlan-live-baseline.md), [E0410](../evidence/0410-wifi-mmcio-mount-root-cause.md), [E0411](../evidence/0411-p4-preload-isolation-result.md))
- **C03** `PHYSICAL` A live Wi-Fi baseline and the SDIO detection contract were recorded; the saved crash does not show whether CMD5 was sent or answered. ([E0412](../evidence/0412-wifi-cmd5-and-live-v1-baseline.md))
- **C04** `PHYSICAL` Camera Wi-Fi works and exposes ScalarWebAPI, which has no Creative Style; the camera ships 221 camera methods and advertises 47, the shutter among the missing. ([E0658](../evidence/0658-wifi-scalarwebapi-and-its-missing-settings.md), [E0659](../evidence/0659-camera-advertises-47-of-221-methods.md), [a6400-scalarwebapi-session](../evidence/cross_model/a6400-scalarwebapi-session.json))

Do not rely on:

- ~~Wi-Fi on the a6400 is blocked: enabling it reboots the camera.~~ **R01** `RETRACTED` ([E0409](../evidence/0409-wlan-live-baseline.md)); see C04: Camera Wi-Fi works and exposes ScalarWebAPI, which has no Creative Style; the camera ships 221 camera methods and advertises 47, the shutter among the missing. *Note: E0658: Wi-Fi works, contrary to what was recorded from a single failing unit.*

### <a id="api-scalarwebapi"></a>ScalarWebAPI over Wi-Fi

`api.scalarwebapi` | process

Sony's Wi-Fi camera API: 221 camera methods shipped, 47 advertised; drives remote shooting.

Aliases: `orb-server`, `Smart Remote Control`, `Imaging Edge Mobile`

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` Camera Wi-Fi works and exposes ScalarWebAPI, which has no Creative Style; the camera ships 221 camera methods and advertises 47, the shutter among the missing. ([E0658](../evidence/0658-wifi-scalarwebapi-and-its-missing-settings.md), [E0659](../evidence/0659-camera-advertises-47-of-221-methods.md), [a6400-scalarwebapi-session](../evidence/cross_model/a6400-scalarwebapi-session.json))
- **C05** `PHYSICAL` Sony's own app drives the camera with a sequence a naive client misses; file access is a different camera mode, not a different method; the portable part of Imaging Edge Mobile is decided by the camera's answers. ([E0660](../evidence/0660-imaging-edge-mobile-control-sequence.md), [E0661](../evidence/0661-what-could-be-ported-from-imaging-edge-mobile.md), [E0662](../evidence/0662-file-access-is-a-camera-mode.md))
- **C06** `PHYSICAL` The a6400 shutter works over Wi-Fi; the drive mode decides which shutter is offered: at Single the list includes actTakePicture, at Continuous it offers startContShooting/stopContShooting instead. ([E0664](../evidence/0664-shutter-works-drive-mode-decides.md))
